title: [Roblox] Don't Wake the Giant: a co-op heist where one loud step can ruin it for everyone
author: Eclipse_08
selftext:
You're a tiny burglar stealing treasure from a sleeping giant, with up to 7 other players. Sprinting, creaky floorboards, crinkly paper and squeaky toys all make noise. Fill the noise bar and the giant wakes up.



Stash your loot in the mouse hole, then get back to the burrow before you're caught, or you lose what you're carrying.



There are 4 rooms to unlock: the Bedroom, Toy Room, Midnight Kitchen and Clockwork Attic.



It's free and just went public, so I'd love to know:

\- Was it clear what to do in your first round?

\- Did getting caught feel fair?

\- What made you want to stop playing?



There's a Report a Problem button in the ? menu if something breaks. Roblox currently limits it to ages 16+. Built with a lot of help from AI tools, including the code and 3D models.
